status_at_registration: planned, measurements unchecked, transfer hypothesis untested
hypothesis: Moving a frozen source winner in its original scan supplies missing examples of threshold repair. A contiguous-set target may transfer better than independent position labels.

source.calibration_use: Report only. No checkpoint, cut or hyperparameter selection.

geometry.long_side: horizontal longer side, tie original length; orient in sensor frame toward positive x then positive y
geometry.changes: horizontal center on that axis only
geometry.relative_to: same frozen v1 incumbent with its existing size, z and PCA yaw

features: First 8192 of the frozen per-input 16384 sampled returns. Recrop each start from this same scan. Use original width and height and length times 5/3. Ten axial bins of width L/6. Distinct XYZ per crop. Features are ten bin fractions, log(1+total distinct points), W/L and H/L. Include empty inputs. Standardize per source on reflected and unreflected natural fit starts only; zero variance columns use unit scale.

training.class_balance: none; equal total weight per original natural row
training.interval: linear 16-class softmax over all nonempty consecutive runs on five ordered actions plus empty, categorical NLL
training.bce: five unconstrained linear logits, sum of the five Bernoulli NLL per example
training.optimizer: deterministic full-batch strongly-convex accelerated gradient from zero, float64, common analytic smoothness bound across both anchor sets per source, identical fixed gradient evaluation count

decoding: Average original and reversed-axis hit probabilities after alignment. For interval, marginalize all intervals containing each action. Choose maximum; equal within 1e-12 favors zero, then smallest absolute movement, then positive canonical axis.
mismatch: For exactly half the ordinary expressions per target, reverse only the ten input bins before frozen scoring. Sort SHA256('axial-mirror-v1|target|ordinal') and take first half. Same mask for both source models on a target, all heads, and duplicated assessment. Counts, shape, labels, coordinate system and outputs are not reversed in this control.

target.cohort: Previously exposed ordinary Validation; six equal-weight directions; 9310 expressions x 2 source models, 18620 records
target.sampling: Original per-expression R183/R97 seed, shared by both sources on that expression

primary: Six-direction macro strict Acc@50 versus v1. Record-level rescues and harms, and conversions among the previously identified 491 five-action but no K16 native Acc@50 opportunities. Secondary Acc@25 and mIoU, and all directions with recording-paired descriptive bootstrap (2000, seed 4171).
decision: Test three separate contrasts at natural target starts: shift_interval vs v1 (system effect), vs repeat_interval (reanchoring), vs shift_bce (structured labels). Compare both shifted heads against their own mirror controls. Do not tune or choose a per-target winner. If natural targets have no net improvement, stop this recipe even if shifted source holdout benefits.
